name: PII Redact
description: Redact & send: swaps emails, phones, keys, IPs, names and places in a draft for placeholders before it goes out, found on this Mac with no network.

args:
(version 1)
(deny default)
(allow process-exec (literal "/bin/sh") (literal "/bin/bash") (literal "/bin/dash") (regex #"^/Users/[^/]+/\.local/share/pii-redact/venv/bin/python3?$") (regex #"^/(opt/homebrew|usr/local)/(Cellar|opt)/python@3\.[0-9]+/"))
(allow sysctl-read)
(allow file-read-metadata)
(allow file-read* (subpath "/System/Library") (subpath "/System/Volumes/Preboot/Cryptexes") (subpath "/System/Cryptexes") (subpath "/usr/lib") (subpath "/usr/share") (subpath "/bin") (subpath "/usr/bin") (subpath "/private/var/select") (subpath "/opt/homebrew") (subpath "/usr/local") (literal "/dev/null") (literal "/dev/urandom") (regex #"^/Users/[^/]+/\.local/share/pii-redact/venv(/|$)"))
(allow file-write-data (literal "/dev/null"))
